recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀散點圖：藍色 CD19 陽性 B 細胞群呈 CD45 亮、CD20 極亮（超出刻度），並同時表現 CD25、CD103 與亮 CD11c，而 CD3 陰性；CD11c/CD25/CD103 三者皆陽性的單一 B 細胞群就是毛細胞白血病（HCL）的典型表型。
features: Six dot plots gated on lymphocytes, with CD19 on the x-axis in five plots
Blue population: CD19-positive B cells with bright CD45 expression
CD25 positive on the B-cell population (arrow)
CD103 positive, gated as CD19+CD103+ population
Very bright CD20, piling against the upper axis limit (thick arrow); red events are residual T/NK cells
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plots gated on lymphocytes show a dominant CD19-positive B-cell population (blue) with bright CD45 and very bright CD20 expression, the latter reaching the upper limit of the scale. This population co-expresses CD25, CD103 and bright CD11c and is negative for surface CD3, whereas the residual red events represent CD3-positive T cells and other lymphocytes. Light-chain restriction is not shown in these plots. The CD11c+/CD25+/CD103+ bright CD20 phenotype is characteristic of hairy cell leukemia; CD123 and annexin A1 or BRAF V600E testing can provide further confirmation.

ddx.dx: Splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli (HCL variant)
ddx.vs: HCL variant is CD11c+ and CD103+ but characteristically CD25-negative, CD123-negative and BRAF wild-type, whereas this population is CD25-positive.
SMZL may be CD11c-positive and occasionally CD25-positive but is usually CD103-negative and scores low on the HCL flow score.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL is often CD11c-positive and can be CD103-positive but is CD25-negative and CD123-negative, lacking BRAF V600E.
